title: The Creation of Adam and Iblees's Pride

paragraphs.text: The people of the Fire will wonder whether they were wrong to mock those men, or whether their eyes simply cannot find them. This arguing among the people of the Fire is true, and it will surely happen.

The Prophet is told to say that he is only a warner. There is no deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing, the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them, the Mighty, the One who forgives again and again. This message is great news, yet people turn away from it. The Prophet had no knowledge of the high assembly of angels when they were disputing. It is only revealed to him that he is a clear warner.

When Allah told the angels that He was going to create a human being from clay, He commanded them to bow down to him in prostration after He had shaped him and breathed into him a soul. So all the angels bowed down together, except Iblees. He was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers. Allah asked him what had stopped him from bowing down to what He had created with His hands, and whether he had become proud or was already among the haughty. Iblees answered, "I am better than him. You created me from fire, and You created him from clay." Allah said, "Then get out of Paradise, because you are cast out. My curse is upon you until the Day of Recompense." Iblees asked his Lord to give him more time until the Day when people are raised from the dead.

hardWords.m: the One who has power over everything
putting the forehead on the ground in worship
very proud and looking down on others
being sent away from Allah's mercy
